image_title: Performance Comparison of T3RL and TTRL
summary: The bar chart compares the performance scores of TTRL and T3RL models across three different tests: AIME, AMC, and MATH. Each test has three bars representing the scores achieved by TTRL, T3RL with a 1.5B Verifier, and T3RL with a 7B Verifier. In the AIME test, TTRL scored 15.8, T3RL (1.5B Verifier) scored 20.8, and T3RL (7B Verifier) scored 21.7. For the AMC test, TTRL scored 48.9, T3RL (1.5B Verifier) scored 50.9, and T3RL (7B Verifier) scored 51.5. In the MATH test, TTRL scored 73.0, T3RL (1.5B Verifier) scored 74.6, and T3RL (7B Verifier) scored 74.9. The chart highlights that T3RL models consistently outperform TTRL across all tests, with the 7B Verifier achieving the highest scores.
